composition_subtypes.role: Sort array to get target order
Map each value to its target index

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort to get target permutation, then use hash map for cycle decomposition to count even cycles.
payload.rationale: The solution combines sorting (to obtain sorted order) and a hash map (for O(1) mapping from value to target index) to decompose the permutation into cycles, which is a multi-step composition.
